content:
Sam O: heads-up: ap-southeast2 apiserver 5xx spike since 11:12 UTC, controller-manager restart loops starting ~11:13. GPU attach errors spiking for the rtx-pool. Prometheus alert: apiserver_5xx_rate x8 :rotating_light:
Ava SRE: I can see leader-election churn in controller-manager logs. lots of `rpc error: code = Unavailable` and `i/o timeout` around the same time.
Ben Infra: any recent network changes in AP-southeast2? peering/route changes?
Sam O: not from infra side AFAIK. Noted a NAT gateway failover around 11:10 in cloud logs.
Ravi: pulling apiserver logs, here's a snippet:
```
W0318 11:12:34.123 apiserver.go:456] apiserver: read tcp 10.12.34.5:6443->10.12.34.9:51876: i/o timeout
E0318 11:12:34.126 etcd: failed to send request: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = transport is closing
```
Ava SRE: also seeing node-level MTU mismatches on a subset of GPU nodes (mtu 1500 vs 9000). Could be packet fragmentation for KV/etcd traffic.
Ben Infra: ahhhh we rolled jumbo frames earlier in eg1 for perf, maybe a subset didn't get the config.
Sam O: AttachVolume errors from kube-controller-manager:
```
I0318 11:13:02.789 controller-manager: AttachVolume.Attach failed for volume "vol-abc" : rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded
```
Ravi: if KV traffic is fragmented, etcd leader heartbeats could be delayed -> apiserver timeouts -> controller-manager retries -> attach loops.
Ava SRE: agreed. Quick mitigation: force controller-manager to backoff more aggressively and reduce concurrent attach workers. Can we patch the controller-manager args?
Ben Infra: we can hotfix DaemonSet that applies MTU to the remaining nodes. Pushing a job to set `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 9000` on the mismatched hosts now.
InfraBot: [action] Created incident INC-2026-2271, severity=high, notify=#oncall. Owner=Ben Infra.
Sam O: good. Meanwhile can we reduce kube-controller-manager `--attach-detach-reconcile-sync-period` to 30s -> 2m? and lower `--concurrent-attaches` from 20->6? small patch will reduce thrash.
Ravi: I can roll a patch to the controller-manager deployment with those flags. Doing a canary to 1 replica first.
Ava SRE: also open to temporarily routing read traffic to eu-west1 fallback for non-GPU control plane calls. That buys time for node fixes.
Ben Infra: MTU job finished on 6 hosts, verifying connectivity.
Sam O: cost note — attach retries are generating burst of billed attach ops and failed job retries. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/gpu-attaches?orgId=1 shows API attach latency up 4x. We should include finance in postmortem.
Ravi: canary patch applied to controller-manager with lower concurrency. Monitoring now.
Ava SRE: leader election stabilized on one replica after patch. apiserver 5xx rate dropping.
Sam O: ok status: MTU mismatch remediation in progress, controller-manager canary patched, incident created. Next actions: 1) finish MTU roll across region (Ben), 2) monitor apiserver 5xx for 30m (Ravi/Ava), 3) cost impact calc + notify finance (Sam).
Ben Infra: starting region-wide MTU config rollout, will post completion timestamp.
InfraBot: [update] INC-2026-2271 severity remains high until apiserver_5xx_rate < 2% for 30m.
Ravi: 11:18 UTC apiserver 5xx down to baseline, controller-manager restarts stopped. Keeping canary for 10m then roll.
Ava SRE: will draft postmortem template with root cause = partial MTU mismatch causing etcd heartbeat fragmentation -> control plane instability -> attach retries.
Sam O: thanks all. ping me if it flares back. :thumbsup:
